card_config.value: Add this card to your hand, or if you have the required energy, perform Raid with it.

card_set: Booster Pack Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Vol.2 [UEX05BT]
card_text:
【Raid】 <Sekido> Switch to active. May move to the front line.
[When Played] Sideline up to one of each of the following characters on your field: <Aizetsu>, <Urogi>, and <Karaku>. If you do, place all the characters sidelined by this ability face down under this character.
This character gains all abilities listed below if you have the required number of face-down cards under this character.
・One or more: [When Sidelined] You may play this card set to resting onto your field.
・Two or more: 【Damage (2)】 and 【Double Block】.
・Three or more: This character gains 500 BP and 【Double Attack】.

regulations.title: One Battle Rule Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
